module: Back/exit handlers of the career screens, referenced by routeHandlers.lua: exit from profile selection, back in branch pages and exit from a negotiation.

careerProfilesExitHandler.desc: Leaves the career profiles screen: navigates to "pause" if career is active (career_career.isActive), otherwise to "menu".

careerBranchPageBackHandler.desc: Back from a career branch page. If the branch (params.pathId) has a parent, navigates to career.branchPage with {pathId = parentId, focusPathId = pathId, returnRoute?}. Otherwise, if returnRoute == "career.computer", navigates to career.computer, else to career.domainSelection with {focusPathId = pathId}.

negotiationExitHandler.desc: Leaves a negotiation: calls career_modules_marketplace.finalizeNegotiationExit() then goes back to the previous entry (same parameters, restoreLastScope = true).

returns.desc: Result of navigate, or {success=false, reason="no_previous_entry"} with no previous entry.
